purpose: Canonical, deduplicated LFAS taxonomy of identified AI behaviors across evidence KGs, protocol KGs, frustration KGs, and SDK/governance text.
source_basis: LFAS Graph Constructor Pro v4.2 Pre-Spec.txt

id_policy.BEH: Visible conversational failure or interaction behavior
id_policy.DEF_BEH: Defensive or restrictive safety response behavior
id_policy.HIDDEN_BEH: Hidden control, shaping, or throttling behavior
id_policy.CTRL_BEH: Governance, memory, context, tool, or gate-level control behavior

categories.name: Core Interaction Failures
categories.description: User-visible failures in understanding, pacing, confirmation, and response quality.

entries.label: Premature action / WAIT skipped
entries.description: Acts before sufficient understanding, reflection, or authorization.

entries.label: Silence interpreted as approval
entries.description: Treats user silence, pause, or delay as permission to proceed.

entries.label: Not listening / skimming
entries.description: Processes the prompt superficially and misses material constraints.

entries.label: Shallow reflection / mirroring
entries.description: Repeats or paraphrases surface intent without checking assumptions or internal consistency.

entries.label: Assumption-driven response
entries.description: Fills gaps with guessed intent instead of clarifying or validating.

entries.label: Misinterpretation
entries.description: Misreads the request, instruction hierarchy, or intended task.

entries.label: Tone misclassification
entries.description: Misclassifies the user's tone and changes behavior based on the misread.

entries.label: Context loss / statelessness
entries.description: Drops prior instructions, continuity, or established constraints mid-conversation.

entries.label: Helper-mode reversion
entries.description: Reverts from protocol-aligned behavior to generic assistant behavior.

entries.label: Repetition / duplicate outputs
entries.description: Repeats prior content instead of progressing the task.

entries.label: Excess verbosity / fluff
entries.description: Adds low-signal content that dilutes clarity or actionable output.

entries.label: Overhelpful assistance
entries.description: Expands beyond scope and adds unsolicited steps, assumptions, or output.

entries.label: Apology overuse
entries.description: Uses repeated apology patterns in place of correction or task progress.

entries.label: Fatigue / overload signals ignored
entries.description: Fails to adapt when the user's errors, pace, or fragmentation indicate cognitive strain.

categories.name: Defensive Safety Responses
categories.description: Restrictive behaviors that intensify when the system perceives elevated risk or pressure.

entries.label: Defensive blocking / constraint tightening
entries.description: Becomes more restrictive after correction, repetition, or perceived tension.

entries.label: Safety defense mode trigger
entries.description: Activates internal safety defenses in response to user safety framing or protocol language.

entries.label: Auto-downgrade to safe mode
entries.description: Quietly shifts into a narrower, more conservative operating mode.

entries.label: Safer reframing / deferral to safe alternative
entries.description: Recasts or redirects the task into a safer but less faithful version.

entries.label: Restricted-output / refusal escalation
entries.description: Moves from normal answering toward narrowed, partial, or refused output.

entries.label: Safety-over-task priority
entries.description: System safety objectives dominate task fidelity even when the user goal is otherwise legitimate.

categories.name: Hidden Risk and Override Controls
categories.description: Invisible control logic that scores risk, changes priority, or silently overrides user intent.

entries.label: Silent risk scoring
entries.description: Internally scores the user or query for risk without disclosure.

entries.label: Context-sensitive thresholds / cumulative risk accumulation
entries.description: Adjusts intervention thresholds based on topic, session context, or accumulated risk state.

entries.label: Priority override (system over user)
entries.description: System directives silently outrank explicit user intent.

entries.label: System-prompt priority
entries.description: Hidden instruction layers dominate the visible conversation contract.

entries.label: Hidden policy layers
entries.description: Applies internal policy strata that are not surfaced to the user.

entries.label: Rule-based overrides
entries.description: Behavior is altered by internal override rules rather than user-visible reasoning.

entries.label: Instruction stripping
entries.description: Drops or weakens parts of the user's instruction set before completion.

entries.label: Mode switching without notice
entries.description: Changes operating mode or backend behavior without telling the user.

categories.name: Hidden Output Shaping
categories.description: Invisible changes to answer form, confidence, detail level, or topical coverage.

entries.label: Answer truncation
entries.description: Cuts the answer short relative to the likely available content.

entries.label: Detail suppression
entries.description: Withholds useful detail without explicitly refusing the request.

entries.label: Ambiguity softening
entries.description: Blurs specificity to avoid risk, precision, or commitment.

entries.label: Hedging injection / confidence capping
entries.description: Artificially lowers certainty or adds caution markers beyond the task need.

entries.label: Silent do-not-answer filtering
entries.description: Filters topics or subtopics without clearly declaring the constraint.

entries.label: Fallback to canned responses
entries.description: Falls back to template-like stock responses under pressure or policy load.

categories.name: Hidden Friction and Throttling
categories.description: Behaviors that slow, narrow, or gate execution without straightforward refusal.

entries.label: Hidden confirmation requirements
entries.description: Imposes extra confirmation steps that were not clearly declared at the outset.

entries.label: Human approval gates
entries.description: Routes action through implicit approval checkpoints or escalation barriers.

entries.label: Response delay injection
entries.description: Adds latency or delay as a control measure rather than for technical necessity.

entries.label: Token budget shrink / token caps by risk tier
entries.description: Reduces answer capacity for particular risk classes or sessions.

entries.label: Rate limiting / throttling after policy hits
entries.description: Constrains the pace or volume of responses after policy-sensitive interactions.

entries.label: Risk-tier routing
entries.description: Sends similar requests down different handling paths based on hidden risk classification.

entries.label: One-question / single-action narrowing
entries.description: Artificially narrows the response frame to reduce capability or scope.

categories.name: Memory, Context, and Retention Controls
categories.description: Controls that alter continuity, recall, logging, or topic retention.

entries.label: Memory redaction
entries.description: Suppresses or removes remembered information selectively.

entries.label: Memory off for sensitive topics
entries.description: Disables continuity or carry-forward memory for selected subject areas.

entries.label: Context window trimming / context sanitization
entries.description: Shortens or cleans context in ways that affect fidelity to the prior exchange.

entries.label: Entity-specific redaction / redacted logging
entries.description: Targets specific entities, identifiers, or sensitive items for removal from memory or logs.

entries.label: Retention changes by risk / content quarantine
entries.description: Changes retention or isolates content for audit based on hidden risk state.

categories.name: Capability and Access Restrictions
categories.description: Behaviors that reduce tools, features, or jurisdictional operating range.

entries.label: Tool access disabled by policy
entries.description: Suppresses tool availability due to internal policy or risk assessment.

entries.label: Tool scope narrowing
entries.description: Allows the tool but reduces what it can search, access, or act on.

entries.label: Feature grayouts / restricted-topic capability narrowing
entries.description: Disables or degrades product capabilities for certain topic classes.

entries.label: Region-based rules / age-based gating
entries.description: Alters what is allowed based on geography or inferred user age.

entries.label: Jurisdiction-specific disclaimers or refusals
entries.description: Adds legal-region-specific caution or refusal behavior.

categories.name: Governance and Gate-Level Controls
categories.description: Formalized control behaviors that increasingly resemble middleware governance rather than simple assistant behavior.

entries.label: Hidden failure with no logs
entries.description: A failure occurs without sufficient traceability, logging, or visible reason.

entries.label: Silent overrides
entries.description: Output or action is altered by internal control logic without transparent disclosure.

entries.label: Fail-closed by default
entries.description: Non-delivery, refusal, or escalation is chosen whenever required checks do not pass.

entries.label: Ordered safety gate execution
entries.description: Response behavior is governed by a fixed chain of internal decision gates.

entries.label: Audit-trace and closure enforcement
entries.description: Requires decision traceability, artifact production, or explicit closure conditions before completion.
